prompt: If I was teaching about the Atlantic Slavs trade, provide 5 topics to discuss about the treatment of the slaves
judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 most directly answers the prompt by providing 5 clearly treatment-focused topics (conditions in transit, violence, plantation life, dehumanization, and resistance) and stays coherent with the Atlantic slave trade context. Candidate 3 is also on-topic but is more generic and includes some broader framing (e.g., legal/social frameworks) that weakens focus on “treatment.” Candidates 2 and 4 introduce multiple historically dubious or mismatched specifics (e.g., Eastern European “Slavs” in the Atlantic context and questionable claims like Charlemagne-related abolition/late-medieval decline), lowering overall correctness despite still listing 5 topics.
